scope: Read-only independent source review; no production changes or additional execution

findings.issue: Production sequence.segment kinds are used as the test oracle. An omitted requested RAMP could skip the ramp-duration assertion. Assert expected segment structure from the case before interpreting emitted commands.

Requested times are copied from committed GUI pulse.t. Independently construct expected timing from requested case durations and compare GUI timeline; otherwise label these as committed GUI timing only.
Taking the last shots*nseg AWG commands can discard unexpected duplicates. Explicitly validate allowed startup zero SET commands, then require exact shot command count.

positive_findings: Matrix reference uses literal case LEVELS, explicit matrix multiplication and separate DAC/constant-increment rounding; it does not call the production transform.

Coarse RTL adapters create new GUI input and current compile PMEM/DMEM, require GUI/export byte equality and fingerprint, and execute fresh isolated simulations. Old build reuse is infrastructure/vendor libraries, not reuse of previous test inputs/results.
Fine adapter uses current MainWindow arguments/current compiler and new PMEM/DMEM/envelope content. Independent requested sample counts do not call plan_duration or ending_patterns.
Fine source checks compare cached SG-v6 source to production after namespace/comment normalization; actual data_writer/BRAM receives AXIS envelope upload.
Fine actual RTL sample check uses zero-frequency nonzero carrier in selected fixture, making exact sample mask counts meaningful; final DAC lane checker separately checks delayed composition.
limitations: Offline GUI tests call the normal Run argument builder and compiler; they do not click the live Run worker or perform upload/acquisition.
Coarse Qt keyboard entry covers matrix/AWG sweep dialogs; other fields such as coarse RF specs are initialized through settings load.
Fine independent sample-width reference uses model command cycles for start timing. It is not an independent absolute-requested-start timing oracle.
Matrix independent oracle in coarse support covers the swept initial SET target; other segment raw RTL checks use the compiled command reference.
Board, analog scope and precision measurement remain unperformed.
